classification.task_class: Evaluation-only bootstrap for bounded isolated unit-test implementation.
classification.domain_risk: Trading-adjacent but non-live tests. Terra pre-decided every scenario. Agy is a mechanical auxiliary and has no product, trading, risk, architecture, or code-organization authority.
classification.reasoning_shape: Translate the exact scenarios below into typed tests without making decisions.
classification.external_resources: The Agy provider and its quota are mutable external resources. The workspace is a sanitized, isolated snapshot with exactly 20 context files and no secrets detected by the recorded preflight.
classification.review_role: Non-review implementer. Independent Terra technical and Luna process reviews follow.
classification.route: Terra owns the trading scenario design. Agy is auxiliary only. Request gemini-3.7-flash-medium with effort medium as a provisional bootstrap evaluation.
classification.fallback: None inside this run. Stop on ambiguity, missing context, or required scope growth.

agy_task.task: Create exactly one new Vitest file: apps/bot/src/bot/strategy-market-event-controller.scenarios.test.ts. Test only StrategyMarketEventController through its public constructor and public methods. The existing boundary test and source files in this snapshot are read-only context.

write_scope.deny: Every other file, including all production, support, configuration, manifest, and existing test files.

required_structure.item: Typed local recorders and minimal Strategy implementations may live in the owned test file.
The file must stay at or below 500 lines.
Use only public types and constructor-injected callback ports.

allowed_fakes.item: Constructor-injected async callbacks that record their public arguments.
The existing PositionManager test support and RecordingLogger.
Minimal Strategy implementations satisfying the public Strategy interface.

prohibitions.item: No production, support, configuration, package, manifest, scope, or threshold change.

No private access, reflection, casts to unknown/private types, any, skips, todos, or impossible-state mocks. The only permitted lint exception is an exact-line unicorn/no-null rationale where Strategy.onCandle returns the public contract's literal null no-signal value.
No assertion padding, weakened expectations, new dependencies, staging, or commits.
No business, financial, trading, architecture, module-boundary, naming, or file-organization decision.
Do not test native protection, paper execution, leverage variants, portfolio close semantics, or any live path.
If the supplied public seam cannot express a scenario exactly, stop and report the blocker without editing another file.

scenario.given: An open long position and a Strategy whose onOpenPositionUpdate returns null.
scenario.when: An enabled LTF OHLCV event arrives.
scenario.then: No close callback and no handleSignal call occur; onCandleObserved runs exactly once.

scenario.given: An open short position; onOpenPositionUpdate returns forceExit true without reason or exitPrice; getPortfolioManager returns undefined.
scenario.when: An enabled LTF OHLCV event whose close is exactly 103 arrives.
scenario.then: requestTrailingStopClose receives the exact position id, close price 103, and reason force_exit; handleSignal is not called. Assert the Strategy receives side sell in its open-position snapshot.

scenario.given: The processPlugins callback changes the injected order-block predicate from false to true.
scenario.when: An enabled LTF OHLCV event arrives.
scenario.then: The plugin callback runs once; Strategy.onCandle and handleSignal are not called.

scenario.given: The StrategyRuntimePolicy symbols list excludes the enabled BTC/USDC symbol.
scenario.when: A BTC/USDC LTF OHLCV event arrives.
scenario.then: Strategy.onCandle and handleSignal are not called.

scenario.given: A Strategy whose timeframes are exactly 1h and 15m.
scenario.then: The received context timeframe is 15m and mtfState.mtf reflects the 15m fallback state.

scenario.given: The same enabled symbol, timeframe, and OHLCV timestamp is delivered twice.
scenario.then: The second received context ltf candleIndex remains exactly 1, proving history de-duplication.
ticksProcessed is exactly 2, while latest price stays undefined and reconciliation callbacks, plugin callback, and signal callback each remain at zero calls.

scenario.given: One Strategy throws an Error from onCandle and a later Strategy returns null.
scenario.when: An enabled LTF OHLCV event arrives.
scenario.then: RecordingLogger contains strategy.candle.handler.failed for the throwing Strategy; the later Strategy still receives its candle; no order is emitted.

acceptance.item: All eight scenarios exist with exact assertions for the stated events and state transitions.
Only the owned new file changes.
No resource-owning fixture is left undisposed; use finally when a fixture acquires a resource.
No test asserts an internal field or fabricated impossible state.

agy_task.isolated_validation: This sanitized snapshot intentionally has no dependency installation. Do not install dependencies. Run git diff --check and wc -l on the owned file. Report full project gates as coordinator-owned and not run here.
agy_task.action_safety: Keep the task strictly scoped. Do not run git add or git commit. Do not infer any missing behavior. Stop and report if any requirement conflicts with the supplied public contracts.
agy_task.structured_output_contract: End with: (1) what changed, (2) exact files touched, (3) scenario/test count, (4) isolated command outcomes, (5) every unrun canonical gate, blocker, deviation, or ambiguity.
